about.title: About Us
about.p1: Training Paradise in the Magic Forest. A unique space created for workshops, seminars, and camps for dogs and their handlers.
about.p2: We offer 3.5 hectares of fully fenced area: vast meadows, a private pond, comfortable summer houses, and a modern training hall.
about.p3: A place designed by dog lovers for dog lovers. An ideal environment to disconnect from everyday life and fully focus on development.
about.p4: A professional training ground (2500 m²), full sanitary facilities, a kitchenette, and comfortable accommodation await you here. You dedicate your time to your passion – we take care of the rest.

descriptions.accommodation: We offer 20 beds in comfortable, 100% dog-friendly cabins. Each has a lockable veranda, and we've placed convenient sanitary stations around the resort to make cleanliness completely hassle-free.
descriptions.pool: The Training Paradise features a private swimming pool for dogs. It's a dream zone for regeneration and cooling down after intense training sessions on warmer days.
descriptions.food: A spacious, fully equipped kitchenette is at your disposal. There's also the option to order full board, allowing you to save time and focus solely on relaxing.
descriptions.infrastructure: The entire resort is a tightly fenced zone with free, internal guest parking. We guarantee complete freedom for dogs, safety, and a total lack of urban distractions.

descriptions.agility: A full-size course compliant with the latest FCI guidelines. 25 professional obstacles – jumps, dogwalks, and tunnels – ready for safe and dynamic training at the highest level.
descriptions.motivation: Train comfortably regardless of the weather. We offer an illuminated outdoor area and an air-conditioned, heated hall with a projector, lined with dog-friendly artificial grass.
descriptions.dummy: A vast, varied, and 100% fenced area providing a dream setting, free from urban distractions, to build motivation and perfect retrieval.
descriptions.frisbee: A massive, flat space ideal for any disc sport. Train dogfrisbee, freestyle, or dartbee on a safe surface with full facilities at your fingertips.
descriptions.obedience: From precision manners training to sports obedience. An ideal, isolated environment to build reliable, responsive communication with your dog.
descriptions.photography: Photography surrounded by pure nature. The Magic Forest provides a beautiful backdrop for outdoor shoots, while the fully equipped multimedia hall ensures excellent conditions for the theoretical part.
descriptions.mantrailing: Harness your dog's incredible sense of smell on highly diverse terrain. Perfect conditions for tracking workshops and building your dog's confidence.
descriptions.communication: A space designed with psychological comfort in mind. A modular system of fences and airlocks allows for safe work and stress-free passing of even the most sensitive dogs.

founder.title: Founder
founder.p1: Agnieszka Kałek is the heart and creator of DOG TOK - Training Paradise. She built this center from scratch, creating a place that combines professional training infrastructure with the incredibly warm, family atmosphere of the Magic Forest. Thanks to years of cooperation with leading trainers and experts, Agnieszka perfectly understands the specifics of the canine industry, ensuring the uncompromising comfort of every event participant.
